card.fact_statement: Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner signed the Washington Peace Accords as the foreign minister of the DRC.
card.source_span: signed by the foreign ministers of the DRC and Rwanda, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner and Olivier Nduhungirehe
